wallet_guide.title: How to use Wallet
wallet_guide.description: Carry your point cards on your smartphone and present barcodes at checkout.

overview.title: What is Wallet?
overview.body: Register barcodes from your point cards and membership cards in the app, and present them on your smartphone screen. You can register up to 200 cards.
overview.hint: You will need to agree to the terms of service the first time you open it.

add_card.title: Register a Card
add_card.body: You can add a new card using the "Add Card" button at the top of the Cards tab. Save time by selecting popular stores from the presets.

steps.step1: Tap the "Add Card" button at the top of the Cards tab
steps.step2: Select from presets for popular stores, or enter a card name directly
steps.step3: Enter the barcode (membership number) via camera, image, or manual input

groups.title: Organize with Groups
groups.body: Group multiple cards together to quickly switch between cards for your favorite stores.

steps.step3: Enter a group name and emoji, and check the cards to include

present.title: Present Barcode at Checkout
present.body: Tap a card from the list to display the barcode in full screen. With groups, you can swipe between cards.

steps.step1: Tap a card from the card list or a group
steps.step2: The barcode is displayed full screen
steps.step3: Hold your smartphone screen toward the staff for scanning
steps.step4: (If biometric authentication is enabled) Unlock with face/fingerprint first
